shared_elements: low-relief motifs carved on a tall vertical monolith/shaft
a symmetrical confronted pair of figures
motifs stacked in registers up the vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief motifs stacked in registers up a tall vertical monument, and both include bird-headed creatures set as a mirrored confronted pair together with curved crossing bands and a prominent ring/disc. The strongest difference is in the specific forms: A is dominated by fully rendered, hatched, profile birds with heavy hooked beaks and interlaced crossing limbs, while B's carvings are sparser, more abstract crescent-and-ring emblems set on an anthropomorphic figure's body, whose head and shoulders have no counterpart in A.
